verdict.rationale: Community users praise JQL and the ability to run useful queries via REST over Jira data (jira-comm-17, jira-comm-16), which shows structured issue search exists. However, building a useful saved search is described as painful (jira-comm-12), and multiple users call Jira heavy and slow (jira-comm-3, jira-comm-15), which undercuts the 'fast' part of the story. Rovo AI connecting Confluence and third-party assets to work (jira-docs-18) only implies cross-tool linking, not unified search. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of search features, evidence of unified search across docs and comments, and evidence of search speed and accuracy.
